name: Hua yi Shan Xin zhi Yue
source:
Step into the heart of The Moonlit Oath, where destinies entwine. An online card strategy RPG—where secrets unravel and fate is yours to shape. 

The Moonlit Oath is a Chinese fantasy strategy RPG game that showcases exceptional storytelling through its distinctive anime art style and exquisite soundtracks. Fight through fierce battles in this fun RPG card game, dress up and makeup your character in unique styles and seek your fate among countless partners in this free, online visual novel game. Choose your allies, seek your heart’s desire, and tread carefully. Your oath, your destiny: Will you follow your heart or unveil the truth in the moonlit whispers of fate?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rgsonline.moonlit]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
走进《花亦山心之月》的世界，见证命运交织。这是一款在线卡牌策略RPG，秘密将逐一揭开，命运由你掌握。

《花亦山心之月》是一款中国奇幻题材的策略RPG，以独特的动漫美术风格和精美配乐展现出色的叙事。体验激烈战斗、为角色更换造型和妆容，并在这款免费的在线视觉小说游戏中与众多伙伴邂逅，寻找自己的命运。选择同伴，追寻心中所愿，谨慎前行。你的誓约，你的命运：你会追随内心，还是揭开命运低语中的真相？

[来源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rgsonline.moonlit]Google Play[/url]]
